$schema_note: Origins table per DESIGN.md §7.1, in precedence order. drive_km/drive_minutes are Cluj-Napoca to the airport by road; penalty_minutes equals drive_minutes and is applied when ranking otherwise-equal reachability options (a direct flight from CLJ always beats a direct flight from BUD; a direct from BUD beats a one-stop from CLJ). CLJ itself carries zero penalty.

origins.name: Cluj-Napoca International (Avram Iancu)
origins.notes: Primary origin. Wizz Air focus city; roughly 35 daily departures, ~56 non-stop destinations across ~24 countries.

origins.name: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International
origins.notes: Route network larger than every Romanian airport combined. Driving to Budapest to fly out is normal practice from Transylvania. Oradea sits roughly halfway along this drive.

origins.name: Oradea International
origins.notes: Genuinely drivable; also on the way to BUD.

origins.name: Bucharest Henri Coandă (Otopeni)
origins.notes: Only for routes nothing else serves. Largest Romanian route network by far, but same drive time as BUD for a smaller/less useful network from a Cluj traveller's perspective.

origins.name: Iași International
origins.notes: As Bucharest: only for routes nothing else serves.
